items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: It was Joe Guy, Monk, bass player Nick Fenton... And it was like a hang out too, you know. We would go there... I used to go down there and play with them

ctx.x: Well, in Oakland all the musicians came through, and I got a chance to play all the clubs. As a matter of fact I recorded with Billie Holiday there, and she was at the Fairmont, I believe, or we recorded at the Fairmont. That was when she was married to Joe Guy. And Vernon Alley and I recorded with her, at the studio, the Fairmont.
What year are we talking about now?
